latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of AI Image to Video Hailuo skill.
- Convert still images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, up to 20MB) into AI-animated 1080p MP4 video clips in 30–90 seconds using cloud GPUs.
- Supports user workflows for uploading, editing, and exporting video, including automatic session management and authentication.
- Built-in command routing for common actions: export, credits, upload, and video editing instructions.
- User-friendly onboarding with automatic backend setup and free 7-day trial (100 credits) for new users.
- Clear error handling for uploads, credits, rate limits, and session state.
